column1: # Output manifest. Tab-separated: pattern, class, regex for "strip". First
# matching pattern wins; patterns are fnmatch-style against paths relative to
# the analysis directory ("*" also matches "/"). A file matching no pattern is
# an error (there is deliberately no catch-all), so a new output type must be
# classified here on purpose rather than silently passing as "exact".
#   exact   identical content (after gzip decompression for .gz)
#   strip   identical after deleting lines that match the pattern's regex
#   numeric identical apart from numbers that differ by at most the relative
#           tolerance in the regex column (unused in this manifest so far)
#   visual  must exist in both; content compared as bytes by golden_hashes.py,
#           with --visual-advisory to downgrade a mismatch to a warning
#   ignore  not compared, and may exist on one side only (logs vary in number)
#   path    identical after each side's own base_dir is replaced by
#           --prefix NAME=BASE_DIR); above the generic patterns these files
#           would otherwise fall into, since the first matching pattern wins
# Run manifest: session IDs, times, host, process ID
# These 5 files per dataset embed the run's own base_dir (identity host=
# container paths, since B4's refactor): above the generic *.txt/figure_data
# patterns below, which would otherwise classify them exact.
# Figure data for plot_figures.R: no R counterpart of its own, but it is the
# data that fully determines every figure, so it is exact, not ignored.
